title_zh: 约定记录活动中心发电机的噪音与排放问题

scenario.label_zh: 约定记录活动中心发电机的噪音与排放问题
scenario.goal_zh: 区分噪音和排放问题，约定记录发生次数并交由维修团队评估

context_zh: 居民反映活动中心备用发电机启动时的情况，中心经理准备交给维修团队核查。
author: author-phase07-c

sentences.speaker: Ravi
sentences.text: The power cuts are becoming more frequent, and the backup generator is right outside my window.

sentences.speaker: Helen
sentences.text: I understand. Is the noise the main problem, or have you noticed anything else?

sentences.speaker: Ravi
sentences.text: The noise is excessive, and there are strong fumes whenever it starts.

sentences.speaker: Helen
sentences.text: I will ask the maintenance team to check the emissions as well as the noise.

sentences.speaker: Ravi
sentences.text: Could they move it to the other side of the building?

sentences.speaker: Helen
sentences.text: Possibly, but moving it would not eliminate the noise. We need a proper assessment first.

sentences.speaker: Ravi
sentences.text: I can record the frequency of the starts. It ran four times yesterday.

sentences.speaker: Helen
sentences.text: That would help. We should also check why we need to generate our own electricity so often.

sentences.speaker: Ravi
sentences.text: I will send you the times from this week, without trying to inspect the machine myself.

sentences.speaker: Helen
sentences.text: Thank you. I will give that record to the maintenance team and ask for an assessment.

targets.sense_zh: 过度的，超出合理程度的

targets.forms_rationale_zh: 使用可数名词的复数 emissions，指发电机排放的气体。
